messages.content: Make one narrow chapter-boundary decision. Return valid JSON only.

A chapter is a large H3 refresh unit.

STORY:
A survey team completes a week of field work. Three months later, the team reunites at a city laboratory to analyze the collected material.

LEFT:
Field work concludes at the remote site.

RIGHT:
Three months later, the team reunites at the city laboratory and begin analysis.

Choose one decision from this allowed set: MERGE, KEEP.
Return a JSON object with "decision" and "reason".
